title: Tile Paint Canonical Representation
description: Grid of clue cells (Kakuro-style right/down shaded-cell counts) and tile cells; thick walls divide the tile cells into tiles that are shaded whole or not at all.

cells.description: rows x cols array. null = tile cell; an object = clue cell with the shaded count of its run to the right and below (null = no number).

h.description: (rows-1) x cols: h[r][c] = 1 when a wall lies below cell (r, c).

v.description: rows x (cols-1): v[r][c] = 1 when a wall lies right of cell (r, c).
